# Motoseyir

> Motoseyir is a motorcycle navigation and route planning app. It plans by distance instead of minutes, offers Back roads and Coast modes, and builds a tour in the direction and for the length of time you choose. It is an iOS app, available on the App Store.

Motoseyir is made for motorcyclists, not for cars: it calculates by distance instead of minutes, so it can pick back roads and shorter alternatives that a car-oriented sat nav skips. The site is available in 14 languages; the English pages are listed below.

## Key facts

- **Is Motoseyir free?** Routing and step-by-step navigation are free and unlimited in Türkiye, Europe and the USA, and no account is needed. The free tier keeps 1 saved tour. AI CoRider, CarPlay, group creation, Discover and unlimited tours come with Pro.
- **How is Motoseyir different from other sat navs?** It works out the route by distance, not by minutes: it compares the alternatives between the same two points and suggests the shortest one. On a multi-stop tour it works out the order of the stops, too.
- **Where does it work?** Routing and navigation work in Türkiye, Europe and the USA. The mountain pass map covers 1,600+ passes in 36 countries.
- **Does it work with CarPlay?** Yes. Apple CarPlay is part of Pro, and your route fills the car screen.
- **Can I ride with friends?** Yes. You take the same route, see everyone on the map and talk over the group intercom. Joining a group by invite or code is free; creating a group is part of Pro.
- Platform: iOS (App Store): https://motoseyir-app.com/en/ has the download link.
- Data: routes and maps are based on OpenStreetMap; sources and credits at https://motoseyir-app.com/veri-kaynaklari/.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/): Motoseyir is a motorcycle navigation app that plans by distance, not minutes. Back roads, tour planning, 1,600+ mountain passes, group rides and CarPlay.
- [Features](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/ozellikler.html): Every feature of the Motoseyir motorcycle navigation app on one page: shortest route, stop order, back roads, legendary routes, tour journal, group riding.
- [How to use Motoseyir](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/nasil-yapilir.html): How to plan a motorcycle route in Motoseyir: building a route, multi-stop tours, ride recording, the tour journal, group riding, the intercom and subscriptions.
- [AI CoRider](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/corider.html): Motoseyir’s AI CoRider talks to you through your helmet: it adds stops, finds places on your route, checks weather and fuel range, and changes the route.
- [Motorcycle route generator (web)](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/motorcycle-route-generator/): Free motorcycle route planner and generator: pick a start, length and how twisty, get up to three round trips of up to 1000 km, send one to your phone.
- [Tour generator in the app](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/tour-generator/): The Motoseyir app's Tour generator takes your start, direction, length and curviness and draws up to three loops to your start. See it in a screen recording.
- [Mountain passes](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/passes/): one page per pass in the US and the Alps with elevation, location, surface and usual closing months, from the app's own pass data.
- [Mountain passes in numbers](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/passes/in-numbers/): original aggregate data from the Motoseyir pass database (1635 passes, 36 countries): tables by region, country, elevation and winter closure, with a citation line and a CSV.
- [About Motoseyir](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/about/): who publishes the app and site, where the data comes from, how guides are written and corrected.

## Guides (English)

- [All guides](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/guides/): Motorcycle route planning and mountain pass guides: heights, seasons, tolls and road notes for the Alps and beyond, with sources. From the Motoseyir team.
- [How to plan a motorcycle ride, step by step](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/guides/motorcycle-route-planner/): How to plan a motorcycle ride: daily distance, road type, stops, fuel and weather. Build the route yourself in Motoseyir, a motorcycle route planner and GPS. Updated 2026-10-25.
- [Alpine passes by motorcycle: heights, seasons and tolls](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/guides/alpine-passes-motorcycle/): Alpine passes by motorcycle: Iseran, Stelvio, Galibier, Gavia, Großglockner and more, with heights, usual open months, tolls and riding notes, all sourced. Updated 2026-10-25.
- [Furka, Grimsel and Susten: the Swiss three-pass loop by motorcycle](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/guides/furka-grimsel-susten-loop/): The Furka, Grimsel and Susten loop by motorcycle: 120 km from Andermatt, pass heights, the order of the climbs, season and what to see on the way. Updated 2026-10-25.
- [Stelvio Pass by motorcycle: the two sides, the season and the plan](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/guides/stelvio-pass-motorcycle/): Stelvio Pass by motorcycle: 2,758 m, 48 hairpins from Prad and 41 from Bormio, no toll, usual open months, the Umbrail descent and how to plan the ride. Updated 2026-11-04.
- [How to plan a motorcycle route without motorways](https://motoseyir-app.com/en/guides/motorcycle-route-avoid-motorways/): How to plan a motorcycle route that avoids motorways and tolls: set stops on back roads by hand, or use Motoseyir's Back roads mode and the route generator. Updated 2026-11-08.
